items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach/reports. Same left knee as last year's PCL sprain/bone bruise—scary history.
items.why: Meniscus trim; Kubiak day-to-day, Schefter realistic W2 chance; working hard.
items.implication: If returns, immediate TE1; if not Mayer continues elevated. Caution on knee history.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; status up in the air for Week 2 vs Raiders, monitored throughout week.
items.why: Rib injury; Harbaugh wants to see how he feels this week.
items.implication: Potential miss elevates other Chargers WRs; monitor practice.

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee) and signed RB Jaleel McLaughlin from practice squad. Judkins saw low routes even after early exit.
items.implication: Judkins primary but low pass-game role so far; Sanders/McLaughlin depth.
items.opportunity: Carries to Judkins; routes still shared

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown placed on IR with high-ankle sprain; expected miss 4-6 weeks (no surgery), earliest Week 6. Beneficiaries Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas per ETR.
items.implication: Long-term absence; NE WR room thin, Doubs/Douglas/Hollins elevated.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. He fucks.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving share as expected post-trade.
items.implication: Elite RB1 weekly floor/ceiling in Chiefs offense.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman/Moore; AJ Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Raheim Sanders; plus Vele, etc. Love/Odunze expected W1, Kamara not.
items.why: Early injury report for waivers; Sunday AM statuses (Love/Odunze expected, Kamara not, Nabers pending).
items.implication: Prioritize handcuffs/replacements on waivers; streamers listed.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty upgrades to high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23-6 for 156 scrimmage + 2 TDs. Every-down player in new scheme.
items.why: Dominant utilization score 99; historical comps average 23 PPG.
items.implication: Lock-in RB1 ROS; sell-high only at massive premium.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected elite efficiency/usage funnel to top 4.
items.implication: Start the core every week; ignore depth.
items.opportunity: Nearly all snaps/targets/carries to these four

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers suffered hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, MRI but would have returned in playoff game. Coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Hamstring; positive signs from sources and coach Jesse Minter.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2; limited risk of extended absence.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, W1 2.5 yards; only 2 targets (7% share) but 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (near Worthy). Needs volume to pay off.
items.why: Routes present but shallow targets/aDOT limit upside without volume spike.
items.implication: WR2/flex if targets rise; otherwise capped.
items.opportunity: Route share strong; target share must improve

items.text: Bucky Irving upgrades to mid-range RB2: 62% snaps, 58% routes, 53% rushes, stayed in LDD, short-yardage work vs Gainwell concerns. 85 util score.
items.why: Held off Gainwell in all phases despite camp noise; positive historical comps.

items.text: Travis Etienne downgrades to low-end RB2: only 43% attempts/38% routes in three-way committee (Kamara out); efficiency good but volume concerns, two-minute may return to Kamara.
items.why: Split work despite Kamara absence; high play volume inflated stats.
items.implication: Flex/RB2 with Kamara return risk; Miller handcuff.

items.text: David Montgomery upgrades high-end RB2: 65% rushes, all inside-5, short-yardage lead in 50/50 split; Marks two-minute. Strong util despite YPC.
items.why: Clear early-down/GL role held in shootout; comps support RB1-2 range.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Limited passing involvement despite backfield injury opportunity.
items.implication: More pure rusher; lower PPR floor than hoped.
items.conflict: Opportunity from Sampson IR not fully converted to routes
